hooks.text: Apollo astronauts discovered the Moon smells like spent gunpowder.
Why did Apollo astronauts smell spent gunpowder on the Moon?
Moon dust inside the Apollo lander smelled like spent gunpowder.

title: Why the Moon Smells Like Spent Gunpowder
description: When Apollo astronauts removed their helmets inside the lander, they discovered lunar dust smelled distinctively like spent gunpowder.
